meta.policy: Keep a queen Miles bed reachable from both sides; nothing may collide or stop a door short; the main walkway from the hall door past the foot of the bed must stay at least 20 inches; bed sides at least 15 inches (today's north side is about 16.75); everything else is a trade-off measured against today. Priorities in order: main walkway, bed-side room, storage, fewest changes, cost.
meta.scenario_basis: Joint scenarios, not confidence bounds. Worst plausible: narrower room, 2.75-in stools, 19-in nightstand and camera hinge shifted north.

search.retained: Analytic invalids filtered; bed-wall / route-pattern / furniture-mix representatives ranked by main route, minimum bed-side strip, storage, fewest changes, dated cost. Bounded wall/floating/constraint-boundary search, not a global optimum.

verdict: Bed east, keep cubes west; laundry south ranks first: a tied-widest 27-in main walkway, with more room at the tighter bed side (24 in).
pinned_verdict: Both pinned dresser requests are invalid: 13-in (56-inch) and 16-in (Miles 48) main routes, pinched by the resting white door.
